_what: The numbers every film is checked against (2026-10-23). One file so the checker (scripts/check-film.mjs) and the films (system/motion.ts) read the same rule. Change a rule here, never in a film. Each value cites where it was settled.

reading._source: studio SKILL.md 'Time on screen': letters / 15 + 1.5 s, never under 1.8 s; a spoken line's caption at least the line plus 0.6 s

pace._source: studio SKILL.md: beats with no text move at about one idea per 1.7 s; the hero sits at 60 to 75% of the runtime

logo._source: Jacob 2026-10-22: logo near the start (inside the first 2 s, never delaying a hook in the first 0.5 s), always at the end

end._source: Jacob 2026-10-23 approved the What Ships finding for the system formats: logo plus campusai.app (Instagram: Link in bio), held about 3 s, never fully still

formats._source: What Ships analysis 2026-10-23 and the pro-process research: launch film about 45 s, single feature 10 to 20 s, scenario triplet 55 to 95 s, bumpers built natively at 6 s

eightBlock._source: Robin Tempe (@robin_linkerpro), 'The perfect structure for short-form content, in 8 blocks', sent by Jacob through Muse; made a format 2026-10-24 (round 3). Opt-in: only a storyboard with "format": "eight-block" is held to it. Each shot names its `block`; the CTA is the film's end card (logo plus campusai.app).

jobs.hook: Pattern break: stops the scroll. Something worth watching inside 0.5 s.
jobs.lead: Retention anchor: a promise that pulls the viewer to the 10 second mark.
jobs.body-1: The first answer, shown on the real product.
jobs.loop-1: Open loop: a question or promise the next body answers, so they stay.
jobs.body-2: The second answer: it closes loop 1.
jobs.loop-2: Open loop: a question or promise the next body answers.
jobs.body-3: The third answer: it closes loop 2. The hero usually sits here.
jobs.cta: Logo plus campusai.app (Instagram: Link in bio), held about 3 s.

lead._why: the lead ends where the 10 second mark is behind the viewer, not before 9 s and not much after

banned._source: studio rules and rules/campusai.md: no em dashes, never Sandy Spring, never ChatGPT, no Maryland imagery (Testudo), no 'Free for UMD students'

maskRects._source: the Maryland M beside the logo in the sidebar, measured 2026-10-22 on the 1440x900 captures (CSS px). x 108 to 112 is our own logo's sparkle, so the patch starts at 116
